name: flowbolt-dev
description: Root task runner: cross-platform dev scripts (macOS, Linux, Windows) mirroring the Makefile for machines without `make`.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,mocks -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev-backend" "pnpm dev-frontend" "pnpm dev-mocks"
scripts.dev-backend: node scripts/kill-ports.mjs 8000 && cd backend && uv run --no-sync python -m uvicorn --app-dir src flow44.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir src/flow44 --reload-exclude "**/__pycache__/**" --reload-exclude "**/*.pyc" --log-level info
scripts.dev-frontend: node scripts/kill-ports.mjs 5173 && cd frontend && pnpm dev -- --port 5173
scripts.dev-mocks: node scripts/kill-ports.mjs 6001 && cd mocks/flapi-mock && pnpm install && cross-env MOCK_PORT=6001 pnpm dev
scripts.install-all: cd frontend && pnpm install && cd ../mocks/flapi-mock && pnpm clean --lockfile && pnpm install && cd ../../backend/pnpm-project-template && pnpm clean --lockfile && pnpm install && cd .. && uv sync
